throughline.zh: 本週從晶圓廠房資產移轉、海外測試設備採購、被動元件與工業電腦第三季財報，延伸到資料中心供電、融資與東南亞工廠機構件進度；各項交易、實績及未來目標分開呈現。
throughline.en: This week spans fab asset transfers, overseas test-tool procurement, passive component and industrial PC earnings, data-center power constraints, financing and Thai manufacturing, distinguishing realized transactions, results and targets.

title.zh: 記憶體、被動元件與電子材料供應
title.en: Memory, passive components and electronics materials

summary.zh: 工研院與泰國騰輝新廠反映稀土及 PCB 材料規劃，旺宏新增 NAND／eMMC 產能、十銓新北模組廠仍待 2027 年開出。國巨 10 月 29 日公布第三季 AI 應用近兩成、MLCC 與鉭電容稼動率接近 95%，未來擴產尚待驗收。
summary.en: ITRI and Tenghui disclosed rare-earth and Thai PCB-materials developments, while Macronix and TeamGroup target 2027 capacity ramps. On October 29 Yageo reported an AI mix near 20% and high MLCC/tantalum utilization, with future capacity still to be qualified.

title.zh: 工廠自動化、製程量測與工業設備
title.en: Factory automation, process metrology and industrial systems

summary.zh: 本週台電復電、鴻海 AI 工廠效率量測與國研院 High-NA EUV 分析技術各為不同實績。中華精測公布探針卡擴產時程，金鞍機械啟用龍潭冷卻設備廠；研華 10 月 29 日公告第三季營收 324.4 億元及接單出貨比 1.64，數據涵蓋工業電腦與半導體設備需求。
summary.en: Taipower restoration, Foxconn workflow measurements and NARLabs high-NA EUV metrology reflect different operating evidence. CHPT described probe-card capacity and Jin-An opened a thermal plant; Advantech reported Q3 revenue of NT$32.44B and book-to-bill of 1.64 across industrial and equipment demand.

title.zh: 資料中心供電、伺服器資金及東南亞能源零組件
title.en: Data-center power, server financing and Southeast Asian power components

summary.zh: MViSTA 海纜招標、馬來西亞資料中心投資意向及新加坡 1.3GW 條件性輸電核准仍未等於機房完工。台達電 29 日說明機房延遲與存貨跌價，技嘉核准 500 億元聯貸，泰國經寶精密則描述 BBU 與電源櫃機構件量產爬坡；三者屬營運說明、融資授權及產線目標。
summary.en: MViSTA's cable tender, Malaysia's data-center investment intention and Singapore's conditional 1.3GW power approval are not commissioned facilities. On October 29 Delta described delayed sites and inventory write-downs, Gigabyte approved NT$50B credit, and Thailand-based JPP reported a power-cabinet and BBU enclosure ramp.

title.zh: 先進封裝、光通訊與半導體測試設備
title.en: Advanced packaging, optics and semiconductor test tooling

summary.zh: 力成先進封裝營收占比與精測探針卡財報為本週已公布數字，FOPLP 與 CPO 仍有產品認證階段；ASMPT SMT 出售未簽約，穩懋光接收產品在產能爬坡。京元電 10 月 29 日公布德州新測試廠土地建物及約 5.34 億美元設備取得，2027 年量產仍屬目標。
summary.en: Powertech's advanced packaging mix and CHPT's probe-card results were reported this week while FOPLP and CPO remain in qualification. ASMPT's SMT sale is unsigned and WIN optical receivers are ramping. KYEC announced Texas property and around US$534M of tool purchases on October 29, with 2027 production still targeted.

title.zh: 晶圓廠房、晶片設計及產業政策
title.en: Wafer facilities, chip design and sector policy

summary.zh: 台菲合作仍屬政策議題、越南 Viettel 晶圓廠建造與 DUV 採購尚有爭議，智原取得 2 奈米晶片設計專案，聯電核准追加擴產預算。友達 29 日決議以 388 億元出售台中廠予台積電，TSIA 同日預估全年產值逾 9.1 兆元；資產交易、研發設計、產能授權與總產值預測是不同類型資訊。
summary.en: Philippine cooperation remains policy discussion, Viettel's fab and DUV status are disputed, Faraday reported a 2nm design project and UMC approved extra expansion budget. On October 29 AUO authorized a NT$38.8B factory sale to TSMC and TSIA forecast annual output above NT$9.1T; property, design, capex and output forecasts are distinct.
